spec.hypothesis: Masking fact reads in either blocks8-15 or16-23 loses all six correct donor answers. Isolate individual blocks at the start/end of the factual concept and its next native token, keeping every preceding state native.
spec.histories: Six certified reference-assisted responses. Three fixed decisions per response: first and last token overlapping its canonical answer concept, then the following native token (native EOS allowed only as an observed diagnostic target).
spec.intervention: For one block at a time, mask only fact-span keys for the final query of a full teacher-forced history. No earlier query or other block is changed. Recompute higher blocks and inspect the repetition-adjusted next-token ranking.
spec.native_attention_measurement: Reconstruct the final query of all14 heads from captured Q/K/V and native RoPE. Verify against pre-o_proj head outputs, then retain fact attention mass and weighted fact values. No virtual output is used as a successful answer.
spec.explicit_mask_control: Compare full additive causal+padding mask against the native implementation on identical positions; require relative last-state difference below2e-5 and the observed native token to remain first.
limitations: Fixed correct reference-assisted histories are observed development, not unprompted or fresh validation.
Local next-token necessity does not prove whole-response sufficiency or a deployable weight change.
This measures one block at a time; distributed and interacting effects can remain.
